## Downloading Jars
You can use the values after `+` to determine what to download:  
**Versions:**  
1.20-1.20.1: `1.20.1`  
1.21.X: `1.21.1`  
1.21.11: `1.21.11`  
**Functions:**  
Full: `full`  
[mRPC](https://docs.tiazzz.me/Khat/development/mrpc): `krpc`  
Only Webhooks: \*nothing*
